chapterTitle: Chapter 19 Aldehydes and Ketones: Nucleophilic Addition Reactions
title: Problem 19-21

pages.text: PROBLEM 19-21 Treatment of 2-cyclohexenone with HCN/KCN yields a saturated keto nitrile rather than an unsaturated cyanohydrin. Show the structure of the product, and propose a mechanism for the reaction.
